name: ModelVariant108_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant108_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (gouraud lines stream from eight joints towards the anchor joint, two ribbon trails follow joint segments, the trail tips fall away as fading quads and textured sparks flash along each trail); for a non-negative request it selects the config record indexed by the request, clears both trails and packs two texture images, otherwise it runs one frame and returns 0 before the trails start, 4 while they run, 1 during the fade and 2 at the end; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the same address in every bound image; the French header-125 and 255 images build it from the same source with the US layout. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
